mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS "userId", r.product_id AS "productId", r.order_id AS "orderId", r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.status, r.created_at AS "createdAt", u.nickname AS username FROM product_review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review (user_id, product_id, order_id, rating, content, images, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{orderId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{status})
